author: Kairos II
title: Refresh CASCADE×Meta alignment with landed zero_crossings + CI
abstract: Re-run the alignment builder on the newly landed zero_crossings.csv, rebuild index_auto, and run CI v1.1.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import build_cascade_meta_alignment, build_index_auto, ci_validate
out_align = build_cascade_meta_alignment.main()
ia_path, n = build_index_auto.build()
out_ci = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({
    "alignment": out_align,
    "index_auto": ia_path,
    "entries_scanned": n,
    "ci_entries_found": out_ci.get("entries_found"),
    "ci_ok": out_ci.get("ok"),
    "ci_with_errors": out_ci.get("with_errors"),
    "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
    "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"
}))
